title: Manila Water repair works to affect NCR, Rizal areas

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Several areas in Metro Manila and Rizal may experience water interruptions starting Wednesday evening, Nov. 4, due to emergency repairs and scheduled maintenance work of Manila Water. The Manila Water said the maintenance activities aim to help maintain and ensure 24/7 water supply to residential homes. “Manila Water is advising all residents of affected areas to store enough water to supply their needs during any service improvement activity,” it said in the advisory. Meanwhile, sudden emergency repairs in some areas were conducted to restore normal water supply and minimize water losses. READ: Manila Water releases November desludging schedule […]...
